summary: Frontend-only verification of iter 283 changes: (1) AreaSwitcher on main-app header, (2) AreaSwitcher in Service Desk sidebar, (3) Master Admin 'Pulse Fitness Portal' impersonation switch, (4) Stores fulfilment queue SLA legend/badges. All four flows verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: AreaSwitcher.js is clean, small, correctly gated by accessibleAreas().length >= 2 — Engineer option correctly hidden for owner@isodemo.com.
MasterAdminPage.handlePulseSwitch falls back to '/dashboard?as=operator' only if it cannot find a Pulse Fitness Ltd org — verified fallback not triggered; primary impersonation path works.
StoresDepartment ageDays/slaTone logic is correct (>2 => amber, >=5 => red).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded iso-demo-org and Pulse Fitness Ltd org.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 verifications passed. Detailed evidence: (1) On /dashboard as owner@isodemo.com, data-testid=area-switcher-btn present at header (x=1263,y=21, right side next to user menu); menu shows area-switcher-main + area-switcher-service-desk; area-switcher-engineer correctly ABSENT. (2) On /service-desk, area-switcher-btn present in left sidebar near 'Log out'; clicking area-switcher-main navigated (window.location) to /dashboard. (3) Master admin: portal-switch-pulse found in AdminSidebar; clicking navigates to /dashboard?impersonation_token=<JWT>. Decoded JWT: user_id=63cfe3e1..., email=portal@pulsefitness.ltd, organization_id=3ece2d0c-57ea-4acd-a6b4-d748478ed117 (Pulse Fitness Ltd org id), role=owner, impersonated_by=admin@pulsefitness.com. Red impersonation banner ('Impersonation Session Active — You are viewing as portal@pulsefitness.ltd. Every action is logged. End session') renders at top. URL does NOT contain 'as=operator'. Note: The header org label shows 'Pulse Fitness AI Head Office' because that is the SITE name inside Pulse Fitness Ltd; the JWT organization_id definitively confirms scoping to Pulse Fitness Ltd, not the platform admin console. (4) Stores Dept action queue rendered with legend 'Oldest first · amber >2 days · red 5+ days' (amber and red colours applied to legend text). Queue was empty (0 items) so no sd-queue-sla-* badges expected — legend renders without errors, matching spec. Rate limit workaround: 40s sleep between login attempts.
